name: up_quark

phase_0.boundary_condition: The color-neutral hadron (proton or neutron) that confines the up quark within a femtometer-scale volume, enforced by the strong interaction's rising potential at distance; the boundary closes over both color-singlet formation and chiral symmetry breaking.

⊢.justification: The uninitialized quantum field state before color charge assignment and confinement — the point-like excitation of the up quark field at a single spacetime coordinate.

⊣.justification: The closed color-singlet boundary of the proton (uud) or neutron (udd) that contains the up quark; no quark exits without hadronization or high-energy collision.

≻.justification: The forward morphism of gluon exchange that binds the up quark with two other quarks into a color-neutral hadron, an irreversible structural transformation.

≺.justification: The contravariant weak interaction process (e.g., beta decay) where an up quark transforms into a down quark via W+ emission, reversing flavor identity.

⋈.justification: Sequential chaining of color charges (red, green, blue) into a color-singlet state; the composition of three quark color lines into a hadron.

⊙.justification: The up quark's self-recognition as a first-generation +2/3 charge fermion; flavor quantum number conserved in strong and electromagnetic interactions.

∈.justification: One up quark state opens into two arms: the three color charges (RGB) for strong interaction, and the left/right chiral components for weak interaction.

∋.justification: Rejoining of the three color arms into a color-singlet hadron; the chiral arms recombine into a massive Dirac fermion after electroweak symmetry breaking.

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm: the up quark is successfully confined in a stable hadron (proton), color-neutral and bound.

⊥.justification: The negative arm: a hypothetical free up quark state — constructively refuted by confinement, never observed in isolation.

⊞.justification: The paradice: the up quark simultaneously holds left-handed (weak doublet) and right-handed (weak singlet) chiral components, both live in the massive propagator.

⊡.justification: Permanent fixation of baryon number 1/3; an append-only quantum number that cannot be undone by any Standard Model process.

phase_2.fuse_result: confined_up_quark_in_hadron — color-singlet bound state with definite chirality structure
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: The quantum vacuum before up quark field excitation — no flavor, color, or chirality defined.
phase_3.true_description: Up quark successfully confined in a stable proton (uud), color-neutral, with baryon number 1/3 fixed.
phase_3.false_description: Free up quark state — color-charged, unconfined, violating QCD confinement; constructively refuted.
phase_3.both_description: The up quark as a massive Dirac fermion: simultaneously left-chiral (SU(2)_L doublet) and right-chiral (SU(2)_L singlet), held in the propagator by chiral symmetry breaking; also simultaneously confined (IR) and asymptotically free (UV).

steps.domain_action: Initialize the bare up quark field at a point — void state, no color, no chirality, no hadron.
Establish flavor identity — this excitation is an up quark, charge +2/3, generation 1.
Split the bare quark into color triplet arm (RGB) and chiral doublet arm (L/R).
On color arm — forward strong binding via gluon exchange toward color-singlet target.
On color arm — compose three color lines (red, green, blue) into color-neutral combination.
On color arm — affirm confinement success: color-singlet hadron formed (proton/neutron).
On chiral arm — reverse via weak interaction: left-handed component couples to W boson.
On chiral arm — hold both chiralities simultaneously: L (weak doublet) and R (weak singlet) in paradice.
On chiral arm — touch the negative: right-handed component has no weak charge, refuted as weak partner.
Rejoin color and chiral arms — color-neutralized hadron with massive Dirac fermion structure.
Self-recognition of the confined up quark — same flavor identity, now dressed by gluon cloud.
Fix baryon number 1/3 permanently — ROM record, irreversible in Standard Model.
Close the hadron boundary — proton or neutron as terminal anchor containing the quark.
Nested split — proton (uud) vs neutron (udd) assembly paths for the up quark.
On proton arm — bind with two up quarks and one down quark (uud configuration).
On proton arm — compose color-singlet from three quarks, electric charge +1.
On proton arm — affirm stable proton formation, lifetime > 10^34 years.
On neutron arm — weak decay path: up quark transforms to down via W+ emission (beta+).
On neutron arm — hold both pre-decay and post-decay flavor states in superposition.
On neutron arm — refute stability: free neutron decays in ~880 seconds.
Rejoin proton/neutron arms — the up quark exists in both nuclear contexts, fused to B.
Fix the nuclear binding record — permanent imprint in nuclear wavefunction.
Final anchor — the up quark as constituent of all ordinary matter, boundary closed.
Second-order split — asymptotic freedom (UV) vs confinement (IR) regimes.
On UV arm — perturbative gluon exchange, coupling decreases with energy.
On UV arm — compose logarithmic running of α_s from renormalization group.
On UV arm — affirm asymptotic freedom: quarks behave as free at high momentum transfer.
On IR arm — non-perturbative flux tube formation, linear potential at large distance.
On IR arm — hold both perturbative and non-perturbative descriptions simultaneously.
On IR arm — refute perturbative description: confinement scale Λ_QCD ~ 200 MeV.
Rejoin UV/IR arms — the up quark exhibits scale-dependent duality, fused to B.
Fix the renormalization group trajectory — permanent record in β-function.
Close the scale boundary — the up quark defined across all energy scales.
Third-order split — electromagnetic vs weak vs strong interaction vertices.
On EM arm — photon coupling to charge +2/3, vector current.
On EM arm — compose with hadronic form factors, charge radius ~0.8 fm.
On EM arm — affirm electromagnetic current conservation, Ward identity.
On weak arm — charged current coupling to W, flavor-changing CKM element V_ud.
On weak arm — hold both vector and axial-vector couplings (V-A structure).
On weak arm — refute pure vector: parity violation maximal in weak charged current.
Rejoin EM/weak arms — electroweak unification at ~100 GeV scale.
Fix the electroweak quantum numbers — permanent record in SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y.
Close the interaction boundary — the up quark fully characterized in Standard Model.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The QCD Lagrangian with SU(3)_color gauge symmetry — translates bare quark fields into confined hadron states via renormalization group flow; extended by electroweak sector SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y for chiral structure.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Gluon exchange mediates color communication between quarks; W/Z bosons mediate weak flavor communication; photons mediate electromagnetic communication; all mediated by gauge boson propagators in the quantum vacuum.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Quantum numbers stored in the quark field's representation: flavor (up), color (RGB), chirality (L/R), baryon number (1/3), electric charge (+2/3), weak isospin (±1/2), hypercharge (1/6).
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Renormalization group scale — UV (asymptotic freedom) to IR (confinement) determines operation order; weak processes scheduled by CKM matrix elements; electromagnetic by fine-structure constant α_em.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Standard Model Lagrangian with measured parameters (m_u ≈ 2.2 MeV, CKM matrix, α_s, α_em, v_Higgs = 246 GeV) — the canonical bootstrap store for all up quark processes.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One unit of color confinement energy (~200 MeV per quark) and one unit of chiral symmetry breaking scale (~250 MeV) per hadronization cycle; additional electroweak scale cost (~100 GeV) for full symmetry restoration.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Deconfined quark-gluon plasma or bare quark state — high entropy, color degrees of freedom unconstrained, chiral symmetry restored.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Confined hadron gas — low entropy, color-neutral bound states, chiral symmetry broken, baryon number fixed, electroweak symmetry broken.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is entropy-conservative because confinement reduces color entropy but increases positional entropy in the hadron gas; chiral symmetry breaking reduces chiral entropy but increases mass entropy; electroweak breaking reduces gauge entropy but increases Higgs entropy; the net information content of the up quark's quantum numbers is preserved across all phase transitions.

⊣=𐑰: The up quark is confined within hadrons (protons and neutrons) in a nested hierarchy where quarks cannot exist freely outside their composite containers.
⊢=𐑼: The up quark operates as a point-like fundamental particle with no internal spatial extension, interacting locally at a single coordinate in quantum field theory.
⊞=𐑳: The up quark participates in asymmetric ratios, appearing twice in protons (uud) and once in neutrons (udd) alongside down quarks.
⊡=𐑭: The up quark carries conserved quantum numbers (baryon number 1/3, color charge) that are integer-winding topological invariants preventing continuous deformation to a trivial vacuum state.
⊙=𐑢: The up quark exists in a stable, confined hadronic phase far from any quantum critical point or phase transition threshold.
⊥=𐑖: The up quark exhibits persistent chirality with distinct left-handed and right-handed components that couple differently to the weak interaction, structurally enforced by the Standard Model gauge symmetries.
≻=𐑑: The up quark participates in irreversible bond formation via the strong interaction, creating structurally transformed bound states (hadrons) with confinement preventing reversal to free quarks.
≺=𐑿: The up quark carries a signed color charge (red, green, or blue) that acts as a single directional pole requiring anti-color acceptance to form color-neutral hadrons.
⋈=𐑐: The up quark interacts via the strong force with near-certainty within hadrons, where color confinement enforces deterministic, geometry-constrained binding with effectively infinite fidelity.
⊤=𐑧: The up quark is kinetically frozen by color confinement, requiring extreme external energy (e.g., quark-gluon plasma conditions) to rearrange its hadronic bound state.
∈=𐑲: The up quark's strong interaction is strictly local, confined to the femtometer scale within individual hadrons with no propagation to neighboring nucleons.
∋=𐑝: The up quark requires the simultaneous presence of two other quarks with complementary color charges to form a color-neutral hadron, a strict conjunctive assembly rule.
